visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young toddler with short dark hair, wearing a white t-shirt and light-wash denim overalls, stands in a kitchen area on a light wood floor. They lean over a large white plastic pet food container with its lid open, using a clear plastic measuring cup to scoop out brown, circular kibble. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of a large, cream-colored Labrador dog wearing a green and orange harness. The dog looks intently toward the floor, its tongue slightly peeking out as it watches the toddler's actions. (3) The toddler turns toward the camera with a bright smile and squinted eyes, holding the measuring cup. They then bend down to a blue plastic bowl on the floor, which currently contains only a few scattered pieces of dog food. Animated sparkles and star graphics appear around the child for visual emphasis. (4) The dog continues to watch the toddler from a side-view perspective. As the toddler interacts with the bowl, animated question marks and rotating cartoon bird icons appear above the dog's head, indicating confusion or anticipation. (5) In the background, two other children are briefly visible sitting at a table with a tablet. The main toddler moves away, and the dog finally lowers its head into the blue bowl to eat the kibble provided.
